description: Recorded query set for R02 retrieval-contract measurement. Each entry names the lanes the contract must run (lanes_ran) when every wanted lane answers, and the text lane's policy (primary = the plan asks for words; skip = no textual requirement and every mandatory requirement answered elsewhere). Measured with stub indexes (no models, no media): passes per query are counted off lanes_ran, and evidence consistency is diffed row for row. Committed BEFORE the routing change was scored against it - the before-report is docs/evidence/mm-r02-retrieval-contract.md.

queries.notes: text-only plan: the text pass is the answer, not overhead.
pure visual plan: no text embedding pass.
queries.query: wide shot of the parking lot

queries.notes: barking reaches the sound lane (R02 routing gap); the ambiguous transcript reading keeps text primary.
fundamentally acoustic: transcript ranking cannot answer it.
on-screen text runs the token join, not an embedding pass.

queries.notes: visual + acoustic + temporal, no words asked for.
